external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member using the library app or a self-service kiosk to borrow, renew, reserve, or return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
external_entities.notes: The interview states that members provide a member identifier and interact through phones or kiosks.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk personnel who manually manage loans and member account blocks through the circulation page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; individual staff and branch cannot be distinguished.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: A phone application through which members request borrowing, renewals, and reservations and which calls the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST service that applies loan rules and is the only component stated to read or write the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Exposure disagreement: Lending service note says "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript says "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." Authentication is uncertain: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."

processes.name: kiosk
processes.description: A self-service branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books being borrowed or returned.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The consolidated database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses, and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The interview corrects the earlier two-database description: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: borrow book
data_flows.description: A member requests a book borrowing operation through the library app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Member and book information for a borrowing request

data_flows.name: renew loan
data_flows.description: A member requests a loan renewal through the library app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.data_description: Member and book information for a loan renewal

data_flows.name: reserve title
data_flows.description: A member requests a title reservation through the library app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Reserving is the same shape, the app asks for a title and the API puts the member in the queue for it.
data_flows.data_description: Member and title information for a reservation

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The library app calls the lending API with member and book or title information.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: Member, book, and reservation request data

data_flows.name: scan book
data_flows.description: A member scans a library card and books at a self-service kiosk.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a member scans their card and the books they are borrowing or returning

data_flows.name: send loan
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a loan record to the lending API after scanning.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.

data_flows.name: send return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a return record to the lending API after scanning.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.

data_flows.name: extend loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff extend a member's loan through the circulation page served by the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan

data_flows.name: clear block
data_flows.description: Desk staff clear a block on a member's account through the circulation page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: or clears the block on the account

data_flows.name: mark returned
data_flows.description: Desk staff manually mark a book as returned through the circulation page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned

data_flows.name: read and write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the consolidated loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations, contact details, and borrowing history

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network where branch kiosks and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The internet over which phones directly reach the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.

trust_boundaries.name: phones
trust_boundaries.description: The phones on which members use the library app.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database has confidential data classification.
assumptions.basis: The database contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and members' full borrowing histories, which are personal and business records.
